text: Mostly by metro and on foot. The metro in Almaty only has one line, but it happens to go right past my university, so it's the quickest option. For shorter trips I walk, which is also a nice way to clear my head after classes.

tips.kk: Жай «метромен» емес, неге дәл солай екені.
tips.ru: Не просто «на метро», а почему именно так.

tips.en: Admits a weakness of the metro but explains why it still works.
tips.kk: Метроның кемшілігін мойындап, бәрібір неге ыңғайлы екенін түсіндіреді.
tips.ru: Признаёт минус метро, но объясняет, почему оно всё равно удобно.
tips.example: only has one line, but it happens to go right past my university

questions.followUp: How long does it take you?
questions.question: How do you usually travel around your city?

text: It's got a lot better recently. There are new electric buses and a proper app that shows when the next one is coming. The main problem is that buses still get stuck in traffic at rush hour, so dedicated bus lanes on the busiest roads would make a real difference.

tips.en: A balanced answer: what works and what does not.
tips.kk: Теңгерімді жауап: не жақсы және не кедергі.
tips.ru: Сбалансированный ответ: что хорошо и что мешает.
tips.example: The main problem is that buses still get stuck in traffic

tips.en: Would make — a conditional for suggesting an improvement.
tips.kk: Would make — жақсарту ұсынысына шартты форма.
tips.ru: Would make — условная форма для предложения улучшения.
tips.example: dedicated bus lanes on the busiest roads would make a real difference

note.en: Be unable to move because of traffic.

questions.question: Is public transport good where you live?

text: Probably, yes, but not while I live in the city centre. Parking is a nightmare, and with the metro and taxis being so cheap, a car would cost me more than it saves. If I move to the suburbs or start a family, though, I think it'll become a necessity rather than a luxury.

tips.en: The answer depends on circumstances — it sounds well thought out.
tips.kk: Жауап жағдайға байланысты — бұл ойластырылған болып естіледі.
tips.ru: Ответ зависит от обстоятельств — это звучит продуманно.
tips.example: but not while I live in the city centre

tips.en: Rather than clearly contrasts two ideas.
tips.kk: Rather than екі ұғымды анық қарама-қарсы қояды.
tips.ru: Rather than чётко противопоставляет два понятия.
tips.example: a necessity rather than a luxury

note.en: At the end of a clause: “however”.

questions.question: Would you like to have a car in the future?

text: I don't mind flying itself, but I find everything around it quite stressful — getting to the airport early, the queues, the security checks. Once I'm actually on the plane, I usually put my headphones on and fall asleep, so the flight goes surprisingly quickly.

tips.en: The speaker separates flying from everything around it — more precise than yes or no.
tips.kk: Автор ұшудың өзін айналасындағыдан бөледі — «иә / жоқтан» дәлірек.
tips.ru: Автор отделяет сам полёт от всего вокруг — точнее, чем «да / нет».

tips.en: Three examples support the word stressful.

questions.followUp: What is the longest flight you have taken?
questions.question: Do you like travelling by plane?

text: I'd guess that cities will have far fewer private cars, especially in the centre. Electric scooters and bike-sharing are already very popular here, and I imagine self-driving taxis will be common within twenty years, although I'm not sure I'd feel comfortable getting into one at first.

tips.en: I’d guess and I imagine show the right caution about the future.
tips.kk: I’d guess және I imagine — болашақ туралы дұрыс сақтық.
tips.ru: I’d guess и I imagine — правильная осторожность для будущего.
tips.example: I'd guess that cities will have far fewer private cars

tips.en: The prediction is supported by what is already happening.
tips.kk: Болжам қазір болып жатқан нәрсемен бекітілген.
tips.ru: Прогноз подкреплён тем, что уже происходит.
tips.example: Electric scooters and bike-sharing are already very popular here
